name: ced_degoog_plugins
description: Degoog extensions by cedhuf — self-hosted integrations for your homelab stack.
author: cedhuf

plugins.name: Hister Slot
plugins.description: Integrates your personal [Hister](https://github.com/asciimoo/hister) history index into Degoog — shows an "In your index" panel alongside search results.

plugins.name: Logotype
plugins.description: Replace the Degoog logo with your own image. Upload via the `!logo` command, control dimensions, and optionally add an intro animation.

engines.name: Hister Engine
engines.description: Native Hister search engine — results in a dedicated tab and via the `!hister` bang shortcut.
